get_upscalers_game.note: verdict, history, dependencies and launch args; the INI editor and image settings answer through their own operations

install_upscaler.note: optiscaler (with sharpness, FG route, ANR, recipe game_files packages, ReShade.ini configuration and game_config settings), dll and helixsr (HLX FSR 4 through HelixSR's own bridge run with python.org's embeddable Python Panel downloads; no latest-release lookup); a game folder moved to another library still removes and reinstalls cleanly (the stored folders are mapped to the current one); the files a user brings (a mod and recipe user_files) go in with the next OptiScaler install

cancel_upscalers_job.note: stops downloads and the checks before the game folder is touched; files already being applied finish, and a HelixSR bridge run is not interrupted

search_upscaler_games.note: identity maps a non-Steam shortcut to a Steam appid; every Windows game is a Steam appmanifest with its real appid, and non-Steam shortcuts are not listed

set_upscaler_identity.note: as search_upscaler_games: Windows games always carry their own Steam appid, so there is no identity to override

refresh_upscaler_wiki.note: the wiki recipes ship bundled (recipes_wiki.json) and are never fetched, so there is no cache to refresh yet

set_upscalers_exe.note: kept under the Linux key exe; links are refused, and analysis, install and in-place changes all use it before the recipe's exe

verify_upscaler.note: result and the log facts Windows reads (observed upscaler, provider, fallback); DLL mode has no log and answers not_run

configure_upscaler.note: no ini_written snapshot for reports yet

record_upscaler_args.note: the companion writes Steam's launch options itself over CDP

get_upscaler_launch_receipt.note: no env or wrapper receipts on Windows; added args live in the install state

adopt_foreign_upscaler.note: moves the foreign items to <state dir>/foreign/<appid>/<time> with a copy of the record inside; refuses links; no ownership step on Windows

restore_foreign_upscaler.note: the backup record is recovered from its folder when Panel's state was wiped

get_upscaler_mod_candidates.note: archives in the shell's Downloads folder (wherever it was moved) and the Desktop, newest first, with the partial download in progress; the folder is the first that exists, else the profile

add_upscaler_mod.note: layout, conflict and size rules and mod_settings as Linux; the file must be under the profile, the download folders or on another drive, never through a link; zip is read in-process, 7z and rar through 7-Zip when installed (with passwords) or Windows' tar.exe without decryption, and a protected archive without 7-Zip answers mod_password_unsupported; only OptiScaler installs carry the mod (not dll or helixsr); no Proton prefix verbs or native DLL overrides (they mean nothing on Windows) and no mod_launch_exe swap of the launch executable

remove_upscaler_mod.note: takes the stored copy away; the game keeps the files until the next install, reported as removed

get_upscaler_user_file_candidates.note: Downloads and Desktop, archives and loose DLLs that carry what the dependency names

add_upscaler_user_file.note: the file is judged and its version read as Linux does (the DLL's version resource first, then the file name) and the next install places it; same path and archive rules as add_mod, without passwords

get_lsfg_status.note: Vulkan layer; Lossless Scaling itself is F5

windows_differences.ingame: the in-game badge is a separate companion window above the game, default mode start (Linux keeps its mode in the front end and defaults to off); no FPS counter, Mako or Lossless lines
